title: 5 Best Pickaxe Enchantments Minecraft Has to Offer
content:
When applying multiple enchantments to your pickaxe using an anvil, be aware that multiple enchantment orders can affect total costs. The same total costs may vary depending on whether you use enchanted books or other means.
Always enchant shears, swords, and tridents with a plan to avoid wasting XP.
If you're wondering how these enchantments compare to armor enchantments like Protection IV or Feather Falling on diamond boots, the principle is similar: The right combination enhances your survival and efficiency.
Some enchantments, like Soul Speed and Quick Charge III, apply to other weapons or armor, but pickaxes have a clear set of best options.
Whether you're walking through nether tunnels with a Silk Touch pickaxe or strip mining with Fortune III, knowing which enchantments to prioritize ensures you make the most of every block.
